title: docs(skills): the lifecycle rule teaches the signed-expiry scope and the retention floor of a packaged sealed object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCEahzFts17HReXUCv1LZP1)_

Fixes #37881

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Related: #31908, #37605, #33773

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：对外发布的技能包里，讲「带防篡改封印的审计对象数据留多久」的那一页改成和现在的平台一致：随包发布的封印对象到期后按整段检查点清理，设置里把保留期改得比对象声明的更短会被拒绝；运行时创建的封印对象照旧按保留期清扫。只改教 AI 的文字，用户无感。
- 为什么：平台行为今天已经合入（审计防篡改专题的最后一块），技能包还在教「到期没做完、设置里可以随意缩短保留期」，照着做的 AI 和实施人员会给客户错误的预期。
- 出错会怎样：只动技能包文字，写错了最多是 AI 学到一句不准的话，可以直接撤回这次修改。
- 要你做的：无，座位复核后交审批人。

## What changes

One published skill page and one eval case of the same bundle, prose only. No code, no ceiling row.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`**

- *Sealing (`seal`)*. The last sentence said expiry is not built, "so the sweeper still deletes sealed rows, which then read as missing". After PR #37605 that holds only for some sealed objects. The section now ends with one paragraph, in the wording the merged changeset, `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` and the `lifecycle.seal` description use:
  - **The scope.** Signed expiry covers objects whose lifecycle is declared in packaged metadata: their sealed rows leave only by whole checkpoints and read as `expired`.
  - **The floor.** On such an object with no `archive`, a retention override below the declared window is rejected and the declared window applies; to keep rows for less time, shorten the declared window.
  - **Every other sealed object** (one created at runtime): the sentence the page carried, kept for that case only. The sweeper still deletes sealed rows, which then read as missing.
- *Operations*, the `retention_overrides` row points at that paragraph ("sealed objects: see § Sealing"), so a reader who starts from the settings table meets the floor.
- The same sentence also said no verifier is built ("a break is recorded but not reported"). `os audit verify` has shipped and reads the checkpoints back, and the new paragraph says how rows read, so that clause is removed. See *Decided in the thread*.

The page teaches behaviour only: what an author declares and what then happens to the rows. It says nothing about how a checkpoint or an expiry is signed.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`** (case 16 only; S1 of contract review 7216914110, claim amendment 7216941615)

- The case graded the two statements the page no longer makes for an object an author declares: `must_contain` held `not reported` and `read as missing`, and the grader passes an answer only when every token appears. It now holds `expired` in their place.
- `expected_output` ended with "Two limits today: no verifier ... until expiry ships ...". It now ends with the three sentences of the new paragraph, and says the prompt's object is one declared in packaged metadata.
- Nothing else in the case moves: the prompt, the other four tokens, `must_not_contain`, and the one-checkpoint-per-organization wording (card 33773's).

**Paid for in the same file (token ratchet, no ceiling moves).** Each cut is restatement, rationale or filler, and what an author needs stays on the page:

| Cut | Where it still lives |
|:--|:--|
| "That's correct for business records — and a guaranteed disk leak for anything append-only." (*Why This Exists*) | the `record` row of *Lifecycle Classes* ("permanent; policies FORBIDDEN") and the rule sentence that follows |
| "— grows forever, exactly the bug" (first *Validation Rules* example comment) | the comment still names the refusal ("Non-record class with no bounding policy"); the reason is the first sentence of *Why This Exists* |
| "(event log, run history, delivery outbox, ephemeral tokens)" in the rule sentence | the *Typical use* column of *Lifecycle Classes*, one use per class |
| "(`beforeInsert` / `afterUpdate` …)" in the intro | the sentence still tells the two meanings of "lifecycle" apart; the hook names are taught on the hooks pages |
| "is atomic-ish and safe by default" (the *Archive-then-delete* bullet lead) | the bullet's own sentence states the guarantee: never hot-deleted before the archive copy succeeded |
| "— telemetry bloat can't touch the business DB" (the *Separation* bullet) | rationale only; the behaviour (the objects move onto that datasource) stays |
| "simply", "physically" (*Safety Semantics*) | filler |

Skill size readings, against `main` @ `f7f9345e`:

| | lines before | lines after | tokens before | tokens after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md` | 199 | 200 | 1931 | 1931 (ceiling 1931) |
| `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` (eval fixture, measured and not ratcheted) | 521 | 520 | 9184 | 9241 |

Net lines across `skills/**`: 0 (the page +1, the eval case -1; the claim's budget is +12).

Decided in the thread (small, listed per the standing rule):

- **The "no verifier" clause is removed here.** It is the `lifecycle.md` :164-166 item of card 33773 (queued, unclaimed). It shares one sentence with the expiry clause this card rewrites, and leaving it would put "no verifier" beside "read as `expired`". The seat agreed in the thread to take that one item here and not to fold the card; a deletion only, which also pays part of the ratchet. Everything else of card 33773 stays with it: the one-checkpoint-per-organization wording (page :131-133 and the eval case's `expected_output`) and the `chainField` teaching. The seat notes this on that card after the merge.
- **Eval case 16 follows the page** (added after the contract review, see *What changes*). `expired` is the token the review named: it is the one word the new paragraph teaches for an object an author declares that the old page did not carry.
- **"(one created at runtime)"** names the other case the way the merged texts do ("an object created at runtime"); the card's own words are "any other sealed object", and both are on the page.
- **Not added, to stay inside the card's three items and the file's ceiling:** that the window is counted to the start of a UTC day and at most 10,000 rows leave per sweep; that rows are kept while no sealer runs; and how a tenant-scoped window applies per chain. `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` carries all three.
- No `Skills-docs:` line: the kind is `none` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
- Branch name: the platform assigned `claude/project-thread-zjjrt8`, so it does not carry the issue number.

## Why

PR #37605 (merged 2026-11-27) made sealed rows of packaged objects expire by whole checkpoints and floored their retention overrides at the declared window. It declared the skill text as a follow-up because `skills/**` is governed. Until the page changes, an agent that writes a sealed object from it expects a settings override to shorten the window, and tells its user that expired sealed rows read as missing.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-read on `main` @ `1e721fdb` before writing: `lifecycle.md` :164-166 and the `retention_overrides` row (:173) still carried the old text, and the blocker is merged (`0296d972`). `main` moved one commit while the branch was open (`f7f9345e`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and one docs page, nothing under `skills/`); it is merged in and the gates above ran on the merged head. The wording was read from the merged changeset (`.changeset/31908-p4c-sealed-expiry.md`), `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx` (*Sealed audit objects*), the `lifecycle.seal` description in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, and the floor's own remedy text in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/retention-floor.ts` ("to keep its rows for less time, shorten the window the object declares").
- Which objects take signed expiry is one predicate on `main` (`takesSignedExpiry`, `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/signed-expiry-scope.ts`); the page says "declared in packaged metadata" and "created at runtime", as the public docs do, and names no internal.
- The *Save Notice* section is served by exact heading (`packages/spec/scripts/skill-served-sections.json`) and is byte-identical to `main`.

## Verification

Read first: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`, the last paragraph of *Sealing (`seal`)*, then the `retention_overrides` row of *Operations*, then case 16 of the eval file. The risk hunk is the new paragraph: each of its three sentences should match what PR #37605 merged.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md 1931 / 1931 (+0)` and exits 0.

Tier H: `skills/**`. Contract review 7216914110 (PASS, one should-fix) read head `ca1303b9`; the eval commit answers its S1, and the delta review over `c68dc00c` is the seat's.

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
